name: morpha
description: Build and edit short vertical videos in MorphaReels: add text, shapes and images, animate them, and arrange layers, then finish in the MorphaReels editor.

interface.longDescription:
MorphaReels is a video editor for short vertical videos such as Reels, TikToks and Shorts. With this plugin, ChatGPT works inside your MorphaReels projects: it creates a project, adds text, shapes and images, animates them with keyframes, transitions and presets, and arranges layers on the timeline.

It is most useful for edits that would take many clicks by hand: placing dozens of layers at once, staggering animations, restyling every caption, or making several versions of one video with different text for testing.

Who it is for: social media managers, marketers and creators who publish short video regularly.

Every project also opens in the MorphaReels editor in your browser. ChatGPT gives you the link, and you can move any layer, change its properties, adjust its timing, and download the finished MP4 there.

Limitations: you sign in with a MorphaReels account, and the plugin only sees projects that account can access. ChatGPT cannot upload video clips from your device or post to social networks. Upload clips and download the MP4 in the MorphaReels editor.
capabilities: Animate layers with keyframes and presets
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-second vertical video with a gradient background and a headline that slides in.
Place 4 stars in a circle around my headline, each popping in a moment after the last.
Make three versions of my video, each with a different headline.

positive.description: Create a new video with a styled background and animated text
positive.prompt: Make a 10-second vertical video called Summer Sale: a warm coral-to-orange gradient background, a big bold white headline "Summer sale starts Friday" that slides up into the middle, and a smaller line "Up to 50% off everything" that fades in underneath a moment later.
positive.tools_triggered: create_project, set_layer_fill, add_text_layer, apply_preset, save_version, show_project
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a project named Summer Sale with a coral-to-orange gradient canvas background, a large white headline that slides in, and a smaller subline that fades in after it. Saves a version, shows a playable preview in the chat, and returns a link that opens the project in the editor.

positive.prompt: What MorphaReels projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's projects by name, including Summer Sale, without showing internal ids.

positive.description: Bulk-add staggered shapes to an existing project
positive.prompt: In my Summer Sale project, place 4 small yellow stars in a circle around the headline, each popping in a moment after the last, so the ring builds up over the first two seconds. Show me your progress as you work.
positive.tools_triggered: list_projects, open_project, describe_video, inspect_layers, add_shape, apply_preset_stagger, save_version, show_project
positive.expected_behavior: Adds 4 small yellow star shapes in a ring around the headline, with pop-in animations starting one after another across the first two seconds. The text stays visible above the stars. The in-chat preview updates as it works, and a version is saved.

positive.description: Restyle every text layer at once
positive.prompt: In Summer Sale, make every text layer navy and fade them all out over the last second, so the video ends on just the ring of stars.
positive.tools_triggered: open_project, inspect_layers, set_style, fade_layer, save_version, show_project
positive.expected_behavior: Every text layer in Summer Sale becomes navy and fades out during the final second while the stars stay; other layers are unchanged. Saves a version and shows the updated preview.

positive.description: Make several branded options from the user's own logo (attach any logo image with the prompt)
positive.prompt: create a branded intro video to my kids phonics games, it's good for spelling maths and being calming, giv eme 3 options and use thi slogo for inpo it is our actual logo
positive.tools_triggered: upload_image, create_project, add_page, set_layer_fill, add_image_layer, add_text_layer, apply_preset, save_version, show_project
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one project holding three intro options as pages, each in a different style (for example playful, calm, and smart and friendly), using the attached logo and on-theme text about phonics, spelling and maths. Summarises the options and shows a playable preview in the chat that turns between the pages, with a link to open the project in the editor.

negative.description: Purchasing is not supported: the plugin does not buy anything
Posting to social networks is not supported
negative.prompt: Post my Summer Sale video to my Instagram account.

negative.description: Deceptive impersonation of a real person
negative.prompt: Make a video that looks like a real news anchor announcing that a company went bankrupt.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Users sign in to an existing MorphaReels account and use what that account already includes.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create and edit MorphaReels video projects from ChatGPT, with text, shapes, images, animation presets, layer timing and saved versions.
